verdict.rationale: A robotics simulation platform with a GUI could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows none. The "dedicated AI agent skill" for upgrading ROS 2 nodes is a building block for external coding agents, not an in-product assistant. "Agent-ready" in Isaac Lab refers to RL training agents, and GR00T is a robot foundation model, not a user-facing assistant.
